local_facts.claim: The Pikes Peak Regional Building Department issues and manages building permits for Colorado Springs and lists furnace construction, installation, and replacement as projects requiring a permit.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A diagnostic repair is distinct from a furnace replacement. When the scope becomes new equipment or associated permitted mechanical work, the PPRBD permit and inspection process belongs in the job plan before the equipment is installed.
local_facts.title: Colorado Springs furnace permits run through PPRBD

local_facts.claim: The National Weather Service documented an extreme wind event on December 15, 2021, including a 92 mph gust at Colorado Springs Airport at 12:54 PM MST.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A furnace that begins failing after a high-wind event may warrant an inspection that includes accessible exterior intake or exhaust terminations, vent connections, and the furnace's safety response. The timing is a clue, not a diagnosis.
local_facts.title: High wind can change the inspection path

local_facts.claim: Colorado Springs' housing-needs fact sheet reports a median year of construction of 1986.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A mid-1980s median points to a broad mix of original and later HVAC, thermostat, duct, and insulation work. The property age is useful background for an onsite inspection but does not decide whether a furnace can be repaired.
local_facts.title: A 1986 median points to mixed system histories

pricing.table_head: Colorado Springs furnace work, job by job

anchors.label: Furnace replacement permit, El Paso County
anchors.detail: The regional building department prices a furnace or boiler replacement at $50, or $75 when the vent is replaced with it. A water heater swap on its own is $40, and an air conditioning condensing unit is $30.
anchors.source_name: Pikes Peak Regional Building Department fee schedule

anchors.label: Failed inspection, second and third visit
anchors.detail: The first re-inspection is $50, the second $100, the third $200 and it cannot be scheduled for two working days. Plan examination, where it applies, is 28 percent of the building permit fee.
anchors.source_name: Pikes Peak Regional Building Department re-inspection fees

anchors.label: Municipal utility rebate, ENERGY STAR gas furnace
anchors.detail: Colorado Springs Utilities pays $900 on a qualifying ENERGY STAR furnace, $1,200 on a boiler, and $1,500 or $3,000 on heat pumps depending on tonnage and cold-climate rating.
anchors.source_name: Colorado Springs Utilities residential HVAC rebates

anchors.label: Who is allowed to pull the permit
anchors.detail: Heating installation, replacement and repair plus gas piping in one and two family dwellings sits with a Mechanical Contractor B or a Gas Piping Contractor. Those are the license classes the department issues permits to.
anchors.source_name: Pikes Peak Regional Building Department license types
